title: Hey guys! Let me know you need help with UI/UX, asset generation, animation, etc.
author: cheyumaama
selftext: I saw comments earlier of people having difficulty getting AI to do their UI/UX, or with asset generation/creation, and even with animations. My current workflow fixes all of these for the most part with manual labor required for a lot of it. Good news is that I'm free and available to help since I'm currently jobless. Whether you're building a 3D game, AAA, pixel, voxel or regular 2D game, and you need help with any of the above, feel free to DM me. I'm a software engineer by profession, so I can look at your codebase as well.
